notes: Identity: the NC-03 Democrat is Dr. Raymond E. Smith Jr. of Goldsboro, former two-term NC House member (District 21, Wayne and Sampson counties), Gulf War veteran and former educator. His campaign's own 19 October 2026 press release (https://www.carolinajournal.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/PRESS-RELEASE_-ICYMI-10.19.26.pdf) describes him as a veteran, educator and football coach; it does not say he is a physician, so the 'physician' in the background given for this run may be wrong (the 'Dr.' title appears to be academic). Passing AI mentions left out as off topic: the same press release says that, asked in the News & Observer candidate questionnaire whether he used AI to answer, he said no because he has 'exponentially more life experience than does AI' (I did not open the News & Observer questionnaire itself); the campaign site footer (https://raymondsmithfornc.com/) says the site was made 'with real human labor & creativity, not artificial intelligence'. The platform page (https://raymondsmithfornc.com/platform) covers ethics, cost of living, health care, infrastructure, veterans and education, with no AI content. Seven web searches ran; none was refused. Searches for superintelligence, extinction, pause, China and AI safety returned nothing about him. No state-legislature AI statements found. I did not open the Reflector, WITN or WCTI interviews.
